title: NASA discovers hidden fires burning beneath the Amazon rainforest
caption:
Standard satellite alerts overlooked roughly forty percent of active fires burning through the eastern Amazon. By analyzing raw thermal data, NASA scientists discovered dozens of blazes creeping under the dense canopy.

Source: Sciencedaily - NASA discovers hidden fires burning beneath the Amazon rainforest
